profile.visual_desc: Muscular human in dark blue shinobi garb with a prominent red waist sash. Wears a full black hood and mask, leaving only glowing eyes visible. Bracers and leggings match the dark tunic.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Cinematic close-up of a masked face with piercing red eyes. Features a dark, textured headband with subtle scrollwork patterns against a deep blue hood.
profile.weapon_desc: Straight-edged katana held with both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Stands upright, facing front-right, holding the katana vertically centered before the masked face.
profile.step2_windup: Drops into a deep crouch, drawing the blade back over the right shoulder to prepare a high-to-low strike.
profile.step3_impact: Lunges forward in a low sweep. A sharp, diagonal golden energy beam flashes from the top-left toward the bottom-right.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the low lunging posture while the golden light trail dissolves into thin air.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc in Frame 4 must strictly follow the 45-degree downward trajectory of the two-handed sword swing.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation matches reference wind-up and slash logic. Stance and VFX alignment remain consistent.
